strings.deletekeyconfirm: Do you really want to delete this user key?
strings.keyiprestriction_help: Enter a specific IP address, or a range of IP addresses that will be the only IP addresses allowed to access this data. Leave empty to disable IP restriction (not recommended).
strings.keyvaliduntil_help: Select an optional date after which the key will no longer be valid (recommended for added security).
strings.privacy:metadata:user_private_key:iprest: The IP address range that this key can be used from.
strings.privacy:metadata:user_private_key:script: The script which is responsible for the user key.
strings.privacy:metadata:user_private_key:timecr: The date and time that the key was created.
strings.privacy:metadata:user_private_key:userid: The user associated with the key.
strings.privacy:metadata:user_private_key:validu: The date that the private key is valid until
strings.userkey_help: Select a saved key that will give users access to the data published by this export plugin, without having to log into Moodle. Select "Create a new user key" to generate a new key when submitting this form.
